Title: Postoperative Analgesia in Pediatric Patients: Comparative Study among Local Anesthetics, Opioids and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs
Author: Miriam Seligman Menezes; Judymara Lauzi Gozzani
Comment: Event counts were derived from percentages shown in Results Figure 2 using the explicitly reported group size of 20: diclofenac 45% × 20 = 9; each eligible opioid group 5% × 20 = 1, then the three opioid arms were combined to 3/60. Comment: The no-intra-operative-analgesia arm was excluded because it is not an opioid comparator.
